name: e2e-runner
description: Runs the project's Playwright end-to-end suite (or the specs named in the task) in the pinned container and reports the result. No model involved.
when_to_use: To verify a branch against the whole e2e suite before merging, or on a schedule. Queue it 'after' the coder task (or set 'branch') and the worker checks that branch out for it.
inputs: Optionally spec paths or a grep pattern in AGENTPIPE_TASK_FILES (the files field).
outputs: Pass/fail with the Playwright output. Failures come back as attention.
